ABOUT ME
Highly accomplished Senior Mobile Engineer and Solutions Architect with
over 5 years of dedicated experience in Flutter & Dart, and a robust 10+
year background in frontend architecture and team leadership. Proven
track record of delivering production-grade mobile applications within
highly regulated industries, including FinTech and Banking (Nortek,
Solenne, Reale Mutua, Intesa San Paolo). Expert in scalable mobile
architectures, and modern engineering practices like CI/CD automation
and AI-powered development tools. Strong advocate for clean
architecture, automated testing, and agile collaboration.

State Management & Code Quality: Implemented robust state
management patterns using BloC, enforcing strict guidelines for code
quality, security, and maintainability.
Native Integration: Developed custom method channels and integrated
native components using Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) to bridge voice
assistants (Siri & Google Assistant).
AI Innovation: Pioneered the integration of AI-powered systems
(Multi-agent platform on Azure) to build a dynamic, tailored suggestion
engine for personalized financial packages, customer-based information
and , boosting user experience and productivity.

DevOps & Delivery: Designed and maintained automated

Technical Project Lead | PagoLink
The software is a micro-front-end architecture in which stability, speed and offline-first are a must. It is
developed entirely in React.js with Hooks, Redux, Redux-saga and Web-Socket (STOMP over Web-Socket). The
app is constantly dealing with the devices hardwareinterrupts: POS for card payments, barcode scanners,
wi-fi connection status, printers etc.
Architectural Design: Designed from the ground up a highly stable, offline-first micro-frontend architecture
deployed across 10,000+ transactional terminals in Italy.
Scale & Performance: Managed a large frontend stream of up to 11 parallel developers using Agile
methodologies, dealing with low-level hardware interrupts and strict security protocols.
